items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and retain only existing reconciliation work. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites; named site rows report $0 commission, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: 4,926 calls, 228 errors, and $901.90 cost. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing costs are absent, budget ceilings are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. Do not dispatch, spend, forecast, expand monetization, or claim financial or causal lift. Minimum evidence: period-aligned attributable revenue, a complete reconciled cost ledger including infrastructure, approved budget ceilings, and a defined learning outcome with maximum cost-to-learn.

Handoff: retain the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation work item only. Preserve aggregate provider commission as unattributed; reconcile revenue, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs for matching periods; record approved budget ceilings and the cost-to-learn threshold. Do not create duplicate telemetry or financial work.
